about: The MCP server the secrets tests start (S-292, 2026-09-26), over stdio and over Streamable HTTP, to prove what a server actually receives without printing any of it. TypeScript: tests/fixtures/mcp-probe-server-mcpsecrets.mjs; Python: tests/fixtures/mcp_tool/probe_server_mcpsecrets.py. Each takes `--http <port>` to serve Streamable HTTP at `http_path` on 127.0.0.1 instead of stdio. `env` answers the value of one of the server's own environment variables, or `unset`; `authorization` answers the Authorization header of the HTTP request that carried the last call, or `none`. Named `server_name` in an agent file, its tools get the names in `qualified`.

tools.name: env
tools.description: The value of one of this server's environment variables, or unset.

tools.name: authorization
tools.description: The Authorization header of the request that carried the last call, or none.
